headline: 摩根出任泰特美術館館長
context: 潔西卡·摩根（Jessica Morgan）確定出任泰特美術館（Tate）新任館長，重回她曾任策展人逾十年的機構。她原本領導紐約迪亞藝術基金會（Dia Art Foundation）逾十年，這次轉任據傳薪水大幅縮水，接手泰特正逢艱難時刻。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Clear frontrunner leaves lucrative role at New York’s Dia Art Foundation to join UK arts organisation at critical juncture Jessica Morgan has been confirmed as the new director of Tate, marking her return to the arts organisation where she worked as a curator for more than a decade, at a critical juncture in its history. Morgan, the clear frontrunner in the race to replace Maria Balshaw, who left this spring after nine years in charge , is currently based in New York, where she has led the Dia Art Foundation since 2015. Continue reading...
sources.title: Jessica Morgan named new Tate director – with ‘big pay cut’ to take job

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: After leading the Dia Art Foundation for over a decade, Jessica Morgan is returning to London to run Tate at a challenging time for the renowned group of art museums.
sources.title: Tate Museums Taps Leader of Dia Art Foundation as Next Director

摩根出任泰特美術館館長

潔西卡·摩根（Jessica Morgan）確定出任泰特美術館新任館長，重回她曾任策展人逾十年的機構。她原本領導紐約迪亞藝術基金會逾十年，據傳這次轉任薪水大幅縮水，而她接手的泰特，眼下正處於艱難時期。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian、The New York Times，2026 年 7 月 22 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
摩根出任泰特美術館館長

潔西卡·摩根確定出任泰特美術館新任館長，重回她曾任策展人逾十年的機構。她原本領導紐約迪亞藝術基金會逾十年，據傳這次轉任薪水大幅縮水，而她接手的泰特，眼下正處於艱難時期。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 7 月 22 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 泰特美術館有新館長了。她是潔西卡·摩根（Jessica Morgan），曾在泰特當策展人十幾年，這次是回鍋。摩根原本在紐約領導迪亞藝術基金會，也待了十幾年，據說這次轉任薪水縮水不少，而她接手的泰特，眼下正碰上艱難時期。
